newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE cocoa in tight band, consolidates gains.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE cocoa in tight band, consolidates gains.

text.p: Cocoa futures were stuck at the top end of Thursday's tight range to end Friday midsession narrowly mixed in slow pre-weekend trade.
Nearby months lost two to three stg by midday while forward positions stood one to three higher.
Benchmark September moved within a 10 stg band to end two down at the intraday low of 1,053 stg a tonne. Its top-point was 1,063 after clearing Thursday's peak of 1,061.
Overall volume was meagre at 1,429 lots.
Traders said the thin dealings were marked by manufacturer buying on the dips and overhead origin selling.
Again there was no significant news.
But sterling's new strength against German mark helped dampen the buying mood.
The pound vaulted above 2.98 marks on Friday for the first time in six years as traders proved unable to resist the lure of higher UK interest rates.

Cocoa has been gradually building an upward momentum since last week's sharp fall to a low of 1,000 stg. But the market remained shy of the key resistance at 1,072, the top of the March-April trading range. -- Jalil Hamid, London newsroom +44 171 542 4985
